The ideas we discussed, including harnessing AI, expanding carbon-free nuclear energy, and expanding workforce development, are critical to keeping America the world's strongest nation.

Tennessee is leading the way to secure America's future for the rest of the 21st Century!

statements.text:
As Chairman of Energy and Water Appropriations, I am leading the fight for America and Tennessee to lead the world in expanding nuclear energy, artificial intelligence, supercomputing, and more.

I will always work to ensure America's future is secured for the rest of the 21st Century.

As Chairman of Energy and Water Appropriations, I am committed to fully funding and supporting our nation's outstanding national labs that are doing critical work to maintain American excellence in nuclear research, AI, supercomputing, and next-generation technologies. (2/2)

The recent achievements we've seen in artificial intelligence are groundbreaking and show that AI is the future.

For the US to continue leading AI development, we will need more abundant, reliable energy from new nuclear technologies.

I questioned DOE Deputy Secretary David Turk on the Administration's efforts to expand new nuclear energy so America will continue to be the world's AI leader.

At Chattanooga Connect 2024, I met with industry leaders, researchers, and local business owners to discuss how Chattanooga and our entire #TN03 community are leading the way in developing new technologies like AI, quantum computing, and more.

As Chairman of Energy and Water Appropriations, I will always work closely with our community's leaders and entrepreneurs to ensure the federal government is a helpful partner, not a roadblock with big government regulation, red tape, and taxes.

I am thrilled to welcome @SecretaryWright to #TN03 to visit @ORNL and Y-12!

Oak Ridge is doing groundbreaking work developing AI and new energy technologies while continuing its long legacy of strengthening our nuclear deterrent.

I look forward to joining Sec. Wright at ORNL!
statements.quoted:
I’m excited to announce I will be traveling to @ORNL  and Y-12 later this week to continue this administration’s efforts to modernize the nuclear stockpile and win the race for AI dominance.

statements.text: Secretary Wright and I will work closely to deliver President Trump’s agenda to unleash American energy and innovation, create America’s New Golden Age, win the AI Arms Race, and make our country energy dominant again!

The race for global power is shifting to technology, with artificial intelligence leading the way. Tennessee is uniquely positioned and poised to do something that the Department of Energy wants to do and that the country needs.
So, taking those three, supercomputing, quantum computing, and AI computing, and putting them together is how we make sure that we can lead and win this AI race.

The rest of the world, our adversaries, are investing in this. I want the United States to dominate in that area. Whether it is energy, AI, pick the discipline, pick the endeavor, I want us to be in first place.

Great to have @ENERGY Under Secretary Gil and @NNSANews Administrator Williams brief my colleagues and me on the @HouseAppropsGOP Energy and Water Subcommittee.
